salou_facade.description: Photorealistic modular 6.0m Catalan Mediterranean townhouse/hotel facade with recessed shopfront glazing & interior, louvered wooden shutters, ornate wrought-iron balcony, striped canvas awning, and backlit neon fascia.

dresden_pillar.description: Photorealistic Dresdner Barock Elbsandstein concave-fluted Corinthian columns, sculpted voussoir arch & keystone cartouche, veined marble niches, and gilded bronze glass wall sconces.

palm_tree.description: Photorealistic Mediterranean Salou coastal palm tree with curved fibrous ringed trunk and crown-pivoted multi-leaflet feathered palm fronds.
palm_tree.swayNote: Oscillate Canopy.rotation.x/z by +-0.03 rad for coastal breeze.

streetlamp.description: Ornate cast-iron Mediterranean coastal lamppost with fluted pedestal, scrolled filigree bracket, glass-paned hexagonal lantern cage, and warm tungsten filament core.

safe.description: Heavy photorealistic brushed-steel vault safe with chamfered armor frame, hinge-pivoted Safe_Door with locking bolts, knurled dial + 3-spoke vault wheel Safe_Dial, and interior gold/cash/jewel trays.
safe.hingeNote: Rotate Safe_Door around Y by -1.8 rad to swing open.

display_case.description: Museum-grade brass/steel-framed glass vitrine on veined dark marble plinth with tufted crimson velvet cushion, ceiling micro-spotlights, and faceted sparkling royal jewel Artifact.

power_box.description: Weathered industrial Securion wall electrical junction box with galvanized steel conduits, armored cables, hinged panel revealing internal copper busbars/breakers, pivoting Breaker_Lever, and recessed Status_LED.

security_camera.description: Architectural bullet CCTV camera with bolted gooseneck bracket, armored cable whip, vented sun hood, multi-element glass lens with IR LED ring, swivel-pivoted Camera_Head, and glowing red Camera_LED.
security_camera.panNote: Rotate Camera_Head around Y to sweep FOV.

door_detailed.description: Detailed framed walnut/steel security door with glazed transom window, brass kickplate, mortise lock cylinder, lever Door_Handle, and edge-hinged Door_Leaf that physically swings open when unlocked.
door_detailed.hingeNote: Rotate Door_Leaf around Y from 0 to -1.65 rad to swing open.

cafe_terrace.description: Salou coastal night promenade bistro terrace cluster: marble-topped brass-rim table with candle lantern, two wrought-iron scroll chairs, terracotta Mediterranean planter, and cast-iron street bollard.

getaway_car.description: Photorealistic European night getaway sports coupe with metallic clearcoat body, tinted glass, interior, headlights/taillights/brakelights, and 4 axle-pivoted wheels.

police_car.description: Photorealistic Catalan Mossos-inspired night patrol cruiser with navy/white/crimson livery, roof LED lightbar, and 4 axle-pivoted wheels.

traffic_car.description: Photorealistic European compact sedan/hatchback for ambient Salou night traffic.

character_mara.description: Photorealistic skeletal-rigged Mara Voss (ex-Securion security engineer) with animated glTF clips.

character_jupp.description: Photorealistic skeletal-rigged Jupp Kowalke (68yo master safecracker in wool overcoat & flatcap) with animated glTF clips.

character_crew.description: Photorealistic skeletal-rigged tactical heist accomplice with gear backpack and animated glTF clips.

character_guard.description: Photorealistic skeletal-rigged Catalan Securion night security guard with peaked cap, lapel radio, flashlight, and animated glTF clips.

character_civilian.description: Photorealistic skeletal-rigged Salou evening promenade pedestrian/witness with animated glTF clips.
